article.headline: Quante Berry totals 26 points for Lamar and Caden Hinker scores 25 in 104-74 romp over Omaha
article.description: — Quante Berry had 26 points, Caden Hinker scored 25 and Lamar rolled to a 104-74 victory over Omaha on Tuesday.
article.linkText: Quante Berry totals 26 points for Lamar and Caden Hinker scores 25 in 104-74 romp over Omaha
article.story: OMAHA, Neb. -- — Quante Berry had 26 points, Caden Hinker scored 25 and Lamar rolled to a 104-74 victory over Omaha on Tuesday. Berry also had three steals for the Cardinals (3-1), while Hinker added six rebounds and three steals. Niccolo Moretti had 17 points and shot 7 for 9, including 2 for 3 from beyond the arc. Justin Bolis led the way for the Mavericks (3-3) with 12 points. Deke Thompson added 11 points and six rebounds, while Cahmai Crosby finished with nine points. Up next: Lamar next plays Sunday against Rice at home, and Omaha will take on UC Davis on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
